exposure: perception of traumatic childbirth during pregnancy
trust in ability to cope with labor pain
outcome: perception of traumatic childbirth in the postpartum period
cohort: The study included 248 pregnant women who were in weeks 36-40 of their pregnancies.
finding: Health anxiety during pregnancy is related to the perception of traumatic childbirth, and a high perception of postpartum traumatic childbirth is significantly associated with higher levels of postpartum depression, anxiety, and stress.
followup_time: three to six weeks after childbirth
